# Frontend — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend.203241bb"></a>**1. The frontend directory is a private Next.js application named 'frontend' (version 0.1.0) declared in frontend/package.json.**
  [`package.json:1-4`](../package.json#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend.4a63769d"></a>**2. The frontend's runtime dependencies are the Next.js framework (next 16.0.5), React (react 19.2.0 and react-dom 19.2.0), and supporting libraries (axios, date-fns, and zustand).**
  [`package.json:13-20`](../package.json#L13-L20)
- <a id="research.frontend.7363fcd8"></a>**3. The frontend's devDependencies provide Tailwind CSS tooling (@tailwindcss/postcss, tailwindcss, daisyui), testing tooling (@testing-library/jest-dom, @testing-library/react, @vitejs/plugin-react, @vitest/coverage-v8, fast-check, jsdom, vitest), and linting and type tooling (eslint, eslint-config-next, typescript, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom).**
  [`package.json:21-38`](../package.json#L21-L38)
- <a id="research.frontend.bf43bc45"></a>**4. frontend/package.json declares npm scripts for development (next dev), building (next build), starting (next start), linting (eslint), and testing (vitest --run and vitest for watch mode).**
  [`package.json:5-12`](../package.json#L5-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend.030b94bb"></a>**5. frontend/tsconfig.json compiles the frontend with strict TypeScript checks, an ES2017 target, bundler module resolution, the react-jsx JSX transform, and a path alias '@/*' mapping to './src/*'.**
  [`tsconfig.json:1-34`](../tsconfig.json#L1-L34)
- <a id="research.frontend.c15fdf17"></a>**6. frontend/next.config.ts configures Next.js with standalone output.**
  [`next.config.ts:1-5`](../next.config.ts#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.frontend.e676a84c"></a>**7. frontend/postcss.config.mjs configures PostCSS with the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin.**
  [`postcss.config.mjs:1-5`](../postcss.config.mjs#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.frontend.c108b046"></a>**8. frontend/eslint.config.mjs configures ESLint with the flat config format, applying the eslint-config-next core-web-vitals and TypeScript rule sets, with global ignores for .next, out, build, and next-env.d.ts.**
  [`eslint.config.mjs:1-16`](../eslint.config.mjs#L1-L16)
- <a id="research.frontend.6249cf22"></a>**9. frontend/vitest.config.ts configures Vitest with the React plugin, the jsdom environment, global test APIs, a setup file at ./src/test/setup.ts, and a path alias '@' resolving to './src'.**
  [`vitest.config.ts:1-19`](../vitest.config.ts#L1-L19)
- <a id="research.frontend.67a7c90f"></a>**10. The production Dockerfile builds the frontend in three stages on node:20-alpine, installs dependencies with npm ci, builds the application with npm run build, runs as a non-root 'nextjs' user, exposes port 3000, and starts the standalone server with node server.js.**
  [`Dockerfile:1-80`](../Dockerfile#L1-L80)
- <a id="research.frontend.c3d93d65"></a>**11. The development Dockerfile runs the frontend on node:20-alpine, installs all dependencies including devDependencies with npm install, exposes port 3000, and starts the development server with npm run dev.**
  [`Dockerfile.dev:1-27`](../Dockerfile.dev#L1-L27)
- <a id="research.frontend.10e6abc2"></a>**12. frontend/fly.toml deploys the frontend to Fly.io as app 'schedgen-frontend' with primary region 'jnb', building from the Dockerfile with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and 2026 semester date build arguments, serving an http_service on internal port 3000 with force_https on a shared-cpu-1x 512mb VM.**
  [`fly.toml:1-42`](../fly.toml#L1-L42)
- <a id="research.frontend.5ac18761"></a>**13. frontend/.dockerignore excludes node_modules, .next, coverage, IDE files, environment files, logs, and git metadata from the Docker build context.**
  [`.dockerignore:1-33`](../.dockerignore#L1-L33)
- <a id="research.frontend.bf3179e8"></a>**14. frontend/.gitignore excludes node_modules, .next, out, build, coverage, environment files, and TypeScript build info from version control.**
  [`.gitignore:1-42`](../.gitignore#L1-L42)
- <a id="research.frontend.fde1b1b5"></a>**15. frontend/package-lock.json is the npm lockfile (lockfileVersion 3) recording the resolved dependency tree for the frontend package.**
  [`package-lock.json:1-20`](../package-lock.json#L1-L20)
- <a id="research.frontend.d63ba81e"></a>**16. frontend/README.md is the standard create-next-app README describing how to run the development server and deploy the app on Vercel.**
  [`README.md:1-37`](../README.md#L1-L37)
